name: ytstats
description: Pilot the ytstats CLI from plain English — pull YouTube channel analytics, transcripts, manage sign-in, switch channels, diagnose failures. Covers 27 commands, the JSON envelope, and interpretation traps.

ytstats.description: The CLI this skill drives. Run via npx without installing, or installed globally for faster startup. 0.8.0 or newer is required: it adds the --segment flag this skill routes to, which earlier versions reject as an unknown option, along with the metric-narrowing warning an agent must read before reporting a segmented figure. The 0.7.1 floor before it existed because 0.7.0's `transcript` returned ZERO cues for every video — captions.download hands back a Blob and the body was read as a string, so a working transcript was indistinguishable from a video with no captions (ok: true plus a DATA_EMPTY warning), and 0.7.1 also normalizes trackKind to upper case, which this skill's ASR guidance branches on.

node.description: Node.js 18 or newer. Required to run ytstats, which is pure JS with no native dependencies.

npx.description: Ships with npm. Used to run ytstats without a global install.

jq.description: Used to extract fields from the JSON envelope without loading whole documents into the conversation.
